activities.title: Sound hunt
activities.text: Pick a sound from a word your child found hard today, like the 'ch' in 'chose'. Find three things at home or at the market that start with that sound.

activities.title: Word cards
activities.text: Write five words your child paused on today on small cards. Read them together each day, and put a card away once the word feels easy.

activities.title: Talk about class-level stories
activities.text: Keep reading stories at your child's class level aloud to them and ask what happened and why. Understanding is a strength, so keep it growing.
